create_causal_lm_batch: create a CausalLMBatch from protobuf requests with tokenized inputs and next token choosers
filter_causal_lm_batch: filter a CausalLMBatch to keep only specific request IDs and update tensors in place
concatenate_causal_lm_batches: concatenate multiple CausalLMBatch instances into a single batch with padded attention masks and past key values
forward_causal_lm: run a forward pass through a causal LM model with input IDs, attention mask, and past key values
generate_token_causal_lm: generate the next token for a CausalLMBatch using logits sampling and stopping criteria evaluation
